chain_words.nuance: pleasing to look at in a gentle way
appealing and likely to draw attention
very striking and impressive to see
so beautiful that it takes the breath away

explanation: These words all describe beauty, from a gentle sense of prettiness to a view so impressive that it takes the breath away. Artworks and novels are often described with these words.

usage_notes.difference: 'Pretty' suggests a lighter, more delicate charm; 'beautiful' suggests a deeper and more widely admired quality.
